guide_solution: (a) It is English which is essential to communicate with the people across the border. (b) But most of our students don’t know how to speak English well. (c) If a student wants to do well in English, he must learn the four skills of English. (d) Learning the grammatical rules is much needed. (e) The students who has good command of English can secure good job in the future.
